mapper.sql: t.* , container.container_no AS container_no , from_loc.code AS from_loc_code , to_loc.code AS to_loc_code , actual_loc.code AS actual_loc_code

FROM wms_device_task t LEFT JOIN wms_container container ON container.id = t.container_id AND container.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN wms_loc from_loc ON from_loc.id = t.from_loc_id AND from_loc.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN wms_loc to_loc ON to_loc.id = t.to_loc_id AND to_loc.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN wms_loc actual_loc ON actual_loc.id = t.actual_loc_id AND actual_loc.deleted = 0
